name: Canvas to PDF

releases.author: 2D3DTreasures
releases.description:
# Canvas to PDF v1.0.2 — Initial Release
Welcome to the initial public release of **Canvas to PDF**
This plugin exports your Obsidian canvas layouts into clean, searchable vector PDF and HTML documents directly on your computer.
###  Key Highlights
* **Searchable Vector Typography**: Text remains selectable, copy-pasteable, and sharp at any zoom level.
* **Dual PDF & HTML Export**: Export as vector PDF, standalone HTML, or both simultaneously.
* **Canvas Connections & Arrows**: Renders connector lines, directional arrows, custom colors, and text labels.
* **Nested Canvases**: Automatically renders sub-canvases embedded inside your main canvas (up to 5 levels deep).
* **100% Offline & Private**: Operates strictly on local loopback (`127.0.0.1`) with zero telemetry or tracking.
---
📖 For full documentation, usage instructions, and known edge cases, visit the (README.md).
releases.name: Canvas to PDF plugin v1.0.2
